faq_heading: Homes near Holly Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Holly Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Holly Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names Holly Elementary. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 1 km away.

Holly Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 10719 150 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Holly Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Holly Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Holly Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
